versions.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

- Initial release of the AI-driven Logo and Brand Identity Tool (free version).
- Enables generation of complete brand kits: logo (with variants), color palettes, font pairing, basic brand guidelines, and social media templates.
- Includes brand personality identification and tailored visual references.
- Supports export, customization, and iterative feedback for personal and startup projects.
- No API key required; recommended to use with AI image tools for best results.
- Printing assets (like business cards, email signatures) are not supported in the free version.
